title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 7, section 34 (Golden Bear Access Road)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 7 No Hunting Areas (Section 8)
Golden Bear Access Road
34 That portion of M.U. 6-22 and M.U. 6-26 contained within the following described boundaries: Within 2 km on either side of the midline of the access road to the Golden Bear Mine from its intersection with the unnamed road between Dease Lake and Telegraph Creek to the Golden Bear Mine Site. [en. B.C. Reg. 46/89, s. 9.]
